senses.gloss: m. (<cite ref="A00973"><he>אזל</he></cite> with anorg. <cite ref="T00000"><he>ר</he></cite>; Syr. <he>עוזילא</he>)
a slender young animal, esp. the young of the gazelle or any similar animal (Reëm).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:9">Targ. Cant. II, 9</cite> <he>א׳ דאיילא</he> (h. text <cite ref="P01075"><he>עֹפֶר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Zevachim 113b:8">Zeb. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דרימא בת יומא</he> (read <he>בר</he>); <cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:2">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite> (corr. as Zeb. l. c.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a young antilope one day old.

R. s. 15</cite> <he>א׳ דאיילתא</he> (<he>עוּרְזִילֵיהוֹן וכ׳</he> pl.) young deer.—Pl. <he>אוּרְזִילִין</he>, <he>אוֹרְ׳</he>; <he>אַרְזִילֵי</he>.
